overall: Partial alignment with significant gaps: GYMAT101 is well-covered in both notes and syllabus reader, but GBPHT121 lacks a syllabus reader and omits Superconductivity in Module 3; GXCYT122 omits E-waste and Climate Change/SDG topics in Module 4; GMEST103 omits CAD in Module 4, includes excluded reverse-section problems in Module 3, and has a corrupted ESE Part A description in its reader; GXEST104 compresses Modules 3 and 4 into a single 3-module structure with heavy omissions of BJT amplifiers, MOSFETs, communication systems, and instrumentation; UCEST105 omits recursion in Module 3 notes and has misaligned module descriptions and syllabus reader placement.
